entries.title: One-Button Arcade
entries.label: Hardware
entries.summary: An ESP32-S3 arcade with one mechanical switch, an OLED display, saved scores, and a custom 3D-printed enclosure.
entries.overview: A pocket-sized arcade with a lifetime press counter, a timed speed round, and saved high scores. One mechanical switch handles play and initials entry; a custom 3D-printed enclosure brings the display, board, and wiring together.

entries.title: Pi Constellation Mapper
entries.label: In progress
entries.summary: A handheld sky-map prototype combining a Raspberry Pi, touch display, GPS, orientation sensor, and Rust interface.
entries.overview: A handheld night-sky explorer and constellation sketchbook. The prototype pairs a Raspberry Pi, touch display, GPS, and orientation sensor with a Rust interface for exploring the sky and creating custom constellations. Enclosure prototypes focus on component fit and usability.

entries.title: ESP32-S3 MP3 Player
entries.label: Working playback
entries.summary: A microSD MP3 player with an external I²S DAC. I isolated storage and audio tests, investigated resets and buffer errors, and got playback working after a library update.
entries.overview: An embedded audio prototype, from failed playback tests to working music. Independent SD and DAC tests narrowed the investigation to streaming and decoding; updating ESP32-audioI2S preceded successful playback in October 2025.

entries.title: C/C++ Programming
entries.label: Coursework
entries.summary: Coursework in modular C and object-oriented C++, including linked data structures, memory management, and persistent storage.
entries.overview: Programs built with linked data structures, classes, inheritance, iterators, and dynamic memory. Practiced modular C and object-oriented C++, using compiler warnings and test cases to work through pointers, input handling, and binary data.

entries.title: Brass & Barley
entries.label: Game project
entries.summary: A custom Minecraft modpack with mechanical building, farming, brewing, compatibility fixes, and an in-game quest guide.
entries.overview: A custom Minecraft modpack centered on mechanical building, farming, and brewing. A curated mod list, compatibility fixes, and an in-game quest guide turn a collection of mods into a connected experience.

entries.title: Fantasy Draft Command Center
entries.label: Side project
entries.summary: A browser-based fantasy-football draft board with saved draft state and offline support.
entries.overview: A small browser app for keeping fantasy-football draft day organized, with player rankings, saved draft state, JSON import and export, and offline support.
